seo.title: Insurance & Cover — Protect your ZCHF | Frankencoin
seo.description: Optional third-party cover for Frankencoin (ZCHF) holders. Depeg Cover, underwritten by Nexus Mutual and available through OpenCover, pays out if ZCHF trades 10% or more below 1 CHF for seven consecutive days.

header.title: Cover against a ZCHF depeg.|Optional, from a third party.
header.subtitle: Depeg Cover is underwritten by Nexus Mutual and sold through OpenCover. It pays if ZCHF trades at least 10% below 1 CHF for seven consecutive days. It is not issued by the Frankencoin Association.

products.title: ZCHF Depeg Cover
products.provider: Underwritten by Nexus Mutual · Sold through OpenCover
products.description: The cover pays holders of ZCHF if the token trades at least 10% below its 1 CHF reference value for seven consecutive days. Cover amount, term and price are set when you buy; the exact terms are in OpenCover's cover wording.

highlights.label: Covered event
highlights.value: ZCHF at least 10% below 1 CHF for 7 consecutive days

covered.title: What is covered
items: A sustained ZCHF depeg: at least 10% below the 1 CHF reference value for seven consecutive days.
ZCHF held in the covered wallet when the event begins.

excluded.title: What is not covered
items: Technical issues that do not themselves cause the depeg.
Bugs or events known or disclosed before the cover began.
"Rug pull" scenarios where protocol controllers take funds within their permissions.
ZCHF held for less than 72 hours before the covered event (OpenCover's wording).

eligibility.title: Who can buy
eligibility.body: Anyone with a wallet that holds ZCHF. OpenCover applies its own eligibility rules and may exclude some jurisdictions; check them before paying.

steps.title: Open OpenCover
steps.body: Open the ZCHF cover page on OpenCover and connect the wallet that holds your ZCHF.

steps.title: Choose amount and term
steps.body: Set how much ZCHF to cover and for how long. The price is quoted before you confirm.

steps.title: Pay and keep the proof
steps.body: Pay the premium and receive an on-chain proof of cover. Keep the ZCHF in the covered wallet.
